title: FROGGER DASH
oneLiner: Hop across the road, dodge speeding cars, and survive as long as you can!
mechanics: Move the frog across a single busy road and back to score.
Cars stream across the screen and hurt the frog on contact.
Each successful crossing earns points and cars gradually accelerate.
The playfield wraps vertically so every hop stays on-screen.
lose: The frog loses when hit by a car.
scoring: Score points for reaching the opposite side of the road and returning.
